description: To’rabek Raufov is an entrepreneur, full-stack developer, project manager, and design enthusiast with a focus on digital products and travel tech.

faq.question: Who is To’rabek Raufov?
faq.answer: To’rabek Raufov is an entrepreneur, full-stack developer, project manager, and design enthusiast. He works on digital products and has a particular interest in travel tech.

faq.question: What projects has To’rabek worked on?
faq.answer: His portfolio includes Tourfixer, AdvoAI, txielts, and GoPrava. Tourfixer is a travel-tech platform, AdvoAI is a legal-AI product he co-founded with khudoykulov.uz, txielts is a free IELTS practice platform, and GoPrava is an ongoing project.

faq.question: What is Tourfixer?
faq.answer: Tourfixer brings together private transfers, local guides, and day trips across Uzbekistan. It is one of the projects in To’rabek’s portfolio and connects with his interest in travel technology.

faq.question: Who co-founded AdvoAI?
faq.answer: To’rabek Raufov co-founded AdvoAI with khudoykulov.uz. Its public interface includes legal questions and tools for working with contracts.

faq.question: Is GoPrava available?
faq.answer: GoPrava is in progress. A public product link and screenshots have not been shared yet. Contact To’rabek on Telegram to ask about the project.

faq.question: How can I contact To’rabek Raufov?
faq.answer: The preferred public contact is Telegram at t.me/t6rabek. You can also find him on GitHub and LinkedIn using the handle t6rabek.
